summary: Add source-shaped pointwise Cartesian/spherical feval and explicit coord call dispatch; restore all ten native evaluation test predicates.
native_predicates: First gate: ten pass; supplemental empty/JIT test fails at empty return. Second gate: supplemental test passes after only empty return dtype repair. Nonempty paths and native predicates unchanged.
native_clause_10: Source stores residual without comparison: nonzero residual is truthy. Literal predicate retained plus independent accuracy bound1e4eps; Python residual1.5543122660729238e-15. This is a native test defect, not a meaningful native accuracy bound.
limitations: Default three-argument __call__ remains legacy spherical/grid; use feval for native Cartesian default. Full implicit-call migration remains open.
Radial slice clauses use existing to_spherefun adapter; colon syntax is not implemented.
Native ndgrid detection optimization is not implemented; equal-shaped arrays use pointwise vmap.
Cartesian outside-ball error is eager only; traced calls require valid points.
Existing NumPy/SciPy code in Ballfun remains unchanged.
